title: A Hybrid Quantum Neural Network to Analyse Big Experimental Powder X-ray Diffraction Data
abstract: arXiv:2609.22376v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Quantitative analysis of experimental powder X-ray diffraction data remains challenging when evaluating complex multiphase materials and noisy measurements. We introduce a hybrid quantum neural network framework designed to extract quantitative parameters, such as phase weight fractions and scale factors, directly from one-dimensional powder diffraction patterns without iterative refinement. The model combines noise-aware classical simulator pre-training with fast downstream fine-tuning on quantum processing unit features, ensuring stability against hardware decoherence. We demonstrate the practical utility of this approach by deploying the trained network onto an IBM quantum computer to analyse experimental X-ray diffraction computed tomography datasets from a three-phase solid oxide fuel cell containing ca. 10,000 patterns and a four-phase lithium-ion battery containing ca. 20,000 patterns). translated_title: 一种用于分析大型实验粉末X射线衍射数据的混合量子神经网络
translated_abstract: 实验粉末X射线衍射数据的定量分析在评估复杂多相材料和含噪测量时仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了一种混合量子神经网络框架，旨在直接从一维粉末衍射图谱中提取定量参数（如相权重分数和标度因子），而无需迭代精修。该模型将噪声感知的经典模拟器预训练与量子处理单元特征上的快速下游微调相结合，确保了对硬件退相干的稳定性。我们通过将训练好的网络部署到IBM量子计算机上，分析来自三相固体氧化物燃料电池（包含约10,000个图谱）和四相锂离子电池（包含约20,000个图谱）的实验X射线衍射计算断层扫描数据集，展示了该方法的实用价值。该网络成功重建了定量……
tldr: 该论文提出一种混合量子神经网络框架，可直接从一维粉末X射线衍射图谱中提取相权重分数等定量参数而无需迭代精修，并成功部署于IBM量子计算机上分析了来自燃料电池和锂电池的数万个实验衍射图谱。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hybrid quantum neural network framework that directly extracts quantitative parameters such as phase weight fractions from one-dimensional powder X-ray diffraction patterns without iterative refinement, and is successfully deployed on an IBM quantum computer to analyze tens of thousands of experimental diffraction patterns from fuel cells and lithium-ion batteries.
